name: Clear Speech to Text
description:
Record from the microphone, transcribe via a local OpenAI-compatible service, then copy text to the clipboard and paste into the focused app (Shift+Insert; Ctrl+Shift+Insert in terminals).

Clipboard: text is written to the clipboard when you stop a recording so it can be pasted, and whatever was in the clipboard before is put back afterwards. Restoring it means the extension reads the current clipboard — it does that only to put the content back, and never sends clipboard contents anywhere.

Recent transcripts: the last few are kept in memory so you can copy one back from the panel menu when a paste went nowhere. They are never written to disk and are dropped when the extension is disabled, which includes locking the screen. Set the count to 0 in preferences to turn the list off.

Language: the spoken language is detected automatically by default; German or English can be pinned in the panel menu.

Network: stopping a recording sends audio to the transcription service configured in settings; by default this is a service on localhost, so no audio leaves the machine.

Keyboard: global shortcut to toggle recording is on by default Super+z; change or disable it in extension preferences. You can still start and stop recording from the panel icon.
